svg.title: Становая тяга с резинкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Barbell deadlift with added resistance band, front three-quarter view. Draw one straight loaded barbell held with both hands. A visible closed-loop flat elastic band is pinned UNDER BOTH SHOES at floor level and runs UP as two taut thin doubled strips, clearly looped securely over the BARBELL shaft near the sides of feet, outside the hands. LEFT: hips and knees flexed, bar plates touching floor, shorter band runs from soles to bar. RIGHT: stand tall, bar at thighs, same band now stretched from soles to raised bar, fully visible and still securely looped on bar. Athlete's hands grip bar, never hold bands directly. No chains, cables, rack or platforms. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
